description: What a public source says has happened to a land banking site since its award, for awards the development ledger cannot place on its own. Read by scripts/funding/build_land_banking_status.py. A 'partner' or 'seeking' entry needs a dated https source and a verbatim quote; a 'none_found' entry records that the award was searched for (council and housing-authority pages, local news, CHFA applicant reports) on its checked date and nothing public was found. Never name a private developer in 'text': the source link carries the name.

fy23-24-city-of-grand-junction-salt-flat.text: The city bought the 21.78-acre site in February 2025 and asked developers for letters of interest. A nonprofit partner applied for 2026 4% tax credits for 62 senior and veteran rental homes on part of it (Haven at Salt Flats); CHFA has not announced that round.
fy23-24-city-of-grand-junction-salt-flat.quote: The City will partner with non-profit and for-project housing developers ... Developer letters of interest are due February 21, 2025

fy25-26-rural-rivergate-lot-5-workforce-.text: The city chose a development partner in October 2025, after a search it opened in June 2025, for about 31 workforce homes on the 1.7-acre Rivergate lot. The city plans to give the land to the partner once agreed milestones are met.
fy25-26-rural-rivergate-lot-5-workforce-.quote: In June 2025, the City launched a search to find a development partner. ... In exchange for developing the lot, the City intends to donate the land to the developer, provided agreed-upon milestones are met.

fy23-24-salida-eastside-senior-living-ap.text: The city bought the 2.6-acre site at 507 Scott Street in May 2025 and contracted a development partner after a July 2025 request for proposals. Its February 2026 application for 9% tax credits (40 senior homes) was not selected; the city plans to apply again in early 2027.

sources.title: City of Salida, Scott Street project page

fy23-24-salida-eastside-senior-living-ap.quote: was not selected ... resubmit again in the next grant cycle in early 2027

fy25-26-rural-leadville-railyards.text: The grantee is buying three lots at the Railyard with an affordable housing developer as partner, to build a 45-home apartment building. The article gives no timeline.
fy25-26-rural-leadville-railyards.quote: a partnership with affordable housing developer ... to build a 45-unit apartment building
